title: Chapter 548
paragraphs: Chapter 548
Episode 145. Premonition (17)
It was no coincidence that Murakan sent off Quicantel and met Misha. Also, it was no coincidence that Jin had been unable to meet Misha while visiting her hideouts until now.
-If you're worried like that, I'll order more manpower to track Misha. This should help alleviate your anxiety, right?
-[...Fine, I get it. It would be much better if we could capture Murakan's sister.]
-It was a shame we narrowly missed her recently. Anyway, I'm more worried about my son than the 12th generation or the Black Dragons.
Misha had been hiding from Zipple's pursuit all this time.
Sensing the unusual atmosphere of the empire, she was preparing to meet Jin.
As for her, it was cautious to participate in the war even after the start of the Sword Emperor's War.
If she was seriously injured in this war, it could cause irreversible problems in all matters of Solderet, which she was managing on behalf of someone else.
However, if Jin was killed or captured, it would not end with just a hiccup, so she joined Murakan directly and stood here.
As another guardian dragon of Jin, her primary duty was to protect him.
Misha transformed into a human and took her place next to Jin. Murakan stood behind them like a giant black mountain, his pumpkin-colored eyes blazing like fire.
"It's been a while."
Misha's solid yet clear voice felt more reassuring than anything else.
'With this, I might be able to exclude the Myungwang Army from the equation.'

The Myungwang Army was literally the last resort. Even if he unfolded that sword and defeated Octavia and the Ghost Legion, Jin, who unfolded the Myungwang Army, would never be able to verify the end of this war firsthand.
The only reason he had the Myungwang Army in mind was because there was no other answer.

Misha, to the best of Jin's knowledge at this point, is arguably one of the strongest dragons. The image of her effortlessly defeating Murakan, who had regained 40% of his power, was vivid in his eyes.
On the way here, Murakan had said something unnecessary to Misha, and as a result, there were traces of blood around his mouth.
It wasn't a serious injury, but it looked like he had taken a good hit, as always.
"I've missed you, Lady Misha."
"I bet. I have a lot to discuss with you. But before that..."
A black spear formed in Misha's hand.
The spear technique named 'Shadowless Spear' by Temer himself had blocked Octavia and the Ghost Legion on the island of Veradin two years ago.
"First, I need to get rid of the nuisances that interfere with our meeting. We're on the same side, right? The child of Zipple."
Octavia's eyebrows twitched.
Octavia's eyebrows twitched.

"Black Dragon Misha... Like two years ago, and now. I thought you were only good at running away, but you're also skilled at hiding in human form. You must have been busy evading the chase, yet you somehow managed to find this place."
Upon hearing this, Misha gave a thin smile.
"I felt it two years ago, and I feel it now. You should learn some manners, shouldn't you? Even when talking with Liol Zipple, he was extremely careful, but your casual speech is rather annoying..."
Everyone who heard her voice felt a chill run down their spine.
Especially Murakan, who hadn't seen Misha show her anger in a long time, was reminded of unpleasant old memories, and his scales seemed to stand on end.
'I've never seen a mortal survive after provoking this monstrous demon... That Octavia guy, whether it's today or some other time, he won't have an easy end.'
Of course, Octavia did not seem intimidated at all.
"Is that so? I didn't know. I'll tell my family's officials. If there's a record of Liol, the former head of the family, using honorifics to you, I'll have it erased."
[Hey, hey. You should stop.]
Murakan, who reflexively opened his mouth, stopped speaking upon sensing Misha's mood.
Naturally, Murakan wasn't trying to give advice out of concern for Octavia.
He was simply worried about how that fierce monster might vent any remaining annoyance and anger on him later.
'Oh, damn. That bastard is getting old, so I can only hope she stops such nonsense. Just wait till I recover my power...'
Not only Jin felt reassured by Misha's unexpected arrival. The Vamel Alliance and the Sword Saints felt the same way.
They were shocked by the fact that even though she stood in front of them, by Jin's side, showing her back, there were no openings at all.
'That's the Black Dragon Misha, the second guardian dragon of our lord. Her presence is no joke.'
'Murakan described her as a horrible existence, even to mention, and the rest of the family seemed terrified... Indeed, she's formidable.'
'She's scary, really scary. I should keep a good eye on her.'
Lata, Valkas, and Amella thought. Everyone else had similar thoughts.
"Until when..."
The energy spreading from the black spear formed a black armor on Misha's body. Fully armed, Misha looked like a grim reaper from legends.
"You may think you can rewrite history at will. But you should face it squarely. The world you dream of is already breaking."
Kwaaaaak-!
Coincidentally, the moment Misha's words ended, the sky flashed and a deafening roar erupted.
It was the clash between the cannon of Kosek, imbued with Kelliark's magic, and Ron's Emperor Sword.
Space, no, the entire sky distorted under the impact, causing a whirlwind.
The protective shield that Jin and Octavia's parties had been maintaining together was torn to shreds by the force.
The magicians reflexively chose to spread the protective barrier again, and the warriors decided to charge towards them.
There was no need for Jin to give commands or signals.
Close combat at an incredible speed. The best a warrior could do against first-rate magicians was precisely that.
Ssssh-!

The Black Spear stretched out first, followed by a flash of light. As before, two years ago, Misha showed monstrous strength in breaking through the center of Octavia's and the Phantom Regiment's protective barrier with a single blow.
As if he had anticipated it, Octavia immediately responded with a counterattack of light magic and attempted to bind Misha's feet with magical power.
The thirty members of the Phantom Regiment reacted almost as quickly as Octavia, setting off magic explosions. All sorts of great magics were being cast without a break.
The swords of the Vamel Alliance and the Sword Saints produced sharp waves of aura.
Dozens of swords and staffs intertwined, and each time, the earth screamed and earthquakes occurred.
‘This is doable.’
In fact, Octavia and the Phantom Regiment were a bit tired.
As the destruction of Octavia's ship, which was destroyed as soon as it touched the ground, proved, their path through the battle of the giants was much longer than that of the Jin's camp.
It was enough to face only the Vamel Alliance and the Sword Saints, but with Misha joining the battle, the story had completely changed.
It was not merely a slight increase in the odds of winning.

Misha was even stronger than Jin had thought, and most importantly, she had more experience dealing with the magic squad called the 'Phantom Regiment' than anyone else in this world. For a whole thousand years.
Even the Phantom Regiment she remembered from the past was incomparable to now. Just as the difference between a Runcandel Knight and a Black Knight.
“Just a moment ago, you described that I had run away from fighting you on that island, but is that really so?”

Misha's Black Spear grazed Octavia's cheek. Between the sprouting droplets of blood, the spearhead entered again, and Octavia knocked the ground with her staff, creating a shock wave of light to block the attack.
Then the speed-of-light thrust unfolded. If it weren't for the Phantom Regiment's protective shield, even Octavia would have been critically wounded.

“I only fought you on that island to kill as few of you as possible. Why? Because if I killed too many, I could get tired in the future. After all, the Zephyr are far from such a neat thing as winning and losing.”
“You're good at bragging.”
Octavia's response was a bit boastful, but it wasn't entirely untrue.
However, strangely enough, all the magic of Octavia and the Phantom Regiment was failing to hit Misha.

While Jin, the Vamel Alliance, and the Sword Saints were holding up, the key fact was that she fully understood the magic of the current generation Phantom Regiment. This was due to the battle two years ago.
Also, Misha possessed a very strange ability, just as Jin could not help but sweat when he first met Misha and saw her abilities.
"You're good at bragging."
Hmm…!
Octavia had no choice but to turn her head at the sudden sound of 'her own voice', even with the enemy's Black Spear looming in front of her.
It was an irresistible force. The next thing that caught Octavia's eye was another version of herself, standing in exactly the same way.
Of course, it was a fake formed by Misha's spiritual energy. But the fake said to Octavia,
"What is this?"
What is this.
An expression that she cannot understand why there is another her instead of her. At that moment, Octavia instinctively realized that all of this was Misha's ability and tried to respond.
But it was already too late. Showing a gap in a fight is always fatal, especially when facing an entity like Misha.
Thud-!
The Black Spear pierced Octavia's shoulder.
"Oh, so you're the Phantom Regiment leader, huh. You managed to dodge it. I wanted to get rid of that untrained mouth of yours."
The Phantom Regiment stepped forward and Octavia backed off, widening the distance between her and Misha.
Unlike their rapid formation change, Misha seemed to have no intention of pushing for an additional attack, smiling.
And then she said,
"Like you guys, I also went against the providence once. How is it, the feeling isn't very pleasant, is it? That's exactly what you guys are doing."
The fake Octavia disappeared, and at that moment.
The dawn sky was distorted once more.
The confrontation between Ron and Kelliark was intensifying over time. The tide was turning in Ron's favor. His sword energy was gradually pushing back Kelliark's magic.

"Your leader also seems to be pushed back by the Sword Emperor. Somewhere, Runcandel is eagerly waiting for an opportunity. Yet, the fact that there are no signs of retreat means that you have something to believe in, right?"
Whatever that is.
You will die without seeing the result.
As Misha continued her words, Octavia had no choice but to grit her teeth.
